items.item_text: Bachelors degree in Psychology, social science, public health, or related field
Experience with data collection, data entry, data management, and quality assurance
2 or more years of research or project coordination experience
Experience using Dedoose or similar qualitative research software

The Semel Institute for Neuroscience and Human Behavior is seeking to hire a part-time Research Assistant to join the Division of Population Behavioral Health to support the innovative 4Youth Project, a community-partnered research initiative focused on improving mental health and social service access for adolescents and young adults from historically underserved communities. The project brings together researchers, youth, schools, healthcare providers, and community partners to develop and evaluate innovative tools that promote emotional well-being and access to support services. Key responsibilities:
Coordinate research activities and support day-to-day study operations
Ensure timely collection, tracking, and organization of research data
Maintain study databases and monitor data quality, completion, and accuracy
Support the development and implementation of research program infrastructure
Communicate project activities and timelines with student researchers and community partners
Collaborate closely with investigators and research staff to support study goals and project deliverables
Proficiency with Microsoft Office, including Excel
Knowledge of research methods, terminology, and research operations
Excellent organization skills and attention to detail
Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with diverse tams and community partners
Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive information appropriately
